# The Calm Text Kit

> 50 calm, copy-paste texts for dating and relationship moments when you don't know what to say. Instant PDF, $4.99. 5 free texts: https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/free-sample.pdf

## Free guides (3 example texts each)
- [What to text him when he goes quiet](https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/texts/what-to-text-him-when-he-goes-quiet/): He used to text all the time, now it's slow. 3 calm, copy-paste texts that name the change without blame, plus what to do after you send one.
- [What to text after a fight (and go first without losing)](https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/texts/what-to-text-after-a-fight/): 3 copy-paste texts to send after an argument with your boyfriend or partner: open the door, take a pause, or own your tone without dropping your point.
- [How to ask "what are we?" over text without scaring him off](https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/texts/how-to-ask-what-are-we-over-text/): 3 calm texts to ask where this is going, if you're exclusive, or what he's looking for. Clear and relaxed, no ultimatums.
- [What to text after a first date](https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/texts/what-to-text-after-a-first-date/): 3 warm, copy-paste texts to send after a first date you liked: say thanks, suggest round two, or just say it first.
- [What to text when you're left on read](https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/texts/what-to-text-when-left-on-read/): One gentle nudge, one straight question, one graceful exit. 3 copy-paste texts for when he reads your message and doesn't reply.
- [How to set a boundary over text (kindly)](https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/texts/how-to-set-a-boundary-over-text/): 3 calm texts to say no, ask for a heads-up, or pause a heated conversation. Kind, clear boundary examples you can copy.
- [How to end things over text, kindly](https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/texts/how-to-end-things-over-text/): 3 respectful texts to end a situationship or early relationship without ghosting. Clear, warm, and final.

## Product
- [The Calm Text Kit](https://texts.uncleleaf.cc/): 7 moments, 50 texts, why each one works. Not a script to make anyone like you; just clear, kind words.
